name: D1 wheel-path support at a current single-packet abstention
hypothesis: The immediately preceding delivered scan sometimes contains direct support at today's query where the current scan is occluded.
variable: Keep each finite round-105 result. At an unknown only, transform both current wheel queries to the preceding capture with integrated measured four-wheel speed and IMU. Run the unchanged support reader on that one earlier cloud.
history: One raw, same-source, same-episode, same-layout, same-visibility packet. Separate the current 40 ms acquisition delay from the preceding 160/180 ms capture interval. Read the two heights from one capture. A stream start or lack of historical support stays unknown.
evidence: All published #105 rows. Source 89037 is descriptive. 89011 and 89023 are retrospective, previously examined validation trajectories. All share simulated precontact motion and one-sided 30 mm synthetic terrain. No new blind runs or independent terrain classes.
thresholds: Retain inclusive 10 mm and signed side, unknown fails. For EACH of 89011 and 89023 require at least one currently unknown masked exit to become correct, and zero wrong numerical fills across ALL clear and masked arrivals. Also report unchanged #105 gate versus the nearest-return comparator. These retrospective checks may justify future testing only.
diagnostics: After sealing measured predictions, compare (1) the last raw value held at its old location and (2) exact inter-capture XY/yaw with the same measured current query. For the eight known masked exit abstentions also verify the delivery query exited the rear of the fixture, and count previous, current, and union-of-both true rear-side ground returns within 150 mm and within the obstacle's lateral strip. Report both point presence and whether their XY convex hull encloses the relevant 0.35 m lookahead wheel-path query. Use |world z| <= 1 micrometre and world x > rear + 1 micrometre. Pose and fixture inputs go to diagnosis only.
external: Full #100 roster of 3 other archived flat native runs, 3 layouts, 12 capture ticks and 2 visibility views (216). No saved deployable onboard IMU sequence. Compare a single scan with the one-older-scan fallback using reference pose for BOTH arms' current query and for cross-capture alignment. This is a secondary geometric check only, not measured-sensor transfer or a promotion criterion.
